mapper.select: SELECT bar_start AS time, open, high, low, close, NULL::bigint AS volume FROM market_bars WHERE symbol = #{symbol} AND bar_start >= #{from} ORDER BY bar_start

SELECT candle_time::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS time, open, high, low, close, volume FROM market_candles WHERE symbol = #{symbol} AND interval = '1d' AND candle_time >= #{from} ORDER BY candle_time
SELECT bar_start AS time, open, high, low, close, NULL::bigint AS volume FROM market_bars WHERE symbol = #{symbol} ORDER BY bar_start DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT close FROM market_candles WHERE symbol = #{symbol} AND interval = '1d' AND candle_time < #{day} ORDER BY candle_time DESC LIMIT 1
